global_prefix: Instrumental only, no vocals, seamless looping video game background music.

tracks.prompt: Warm, peaceful fantasy town theme. Gentle acoustic lute, soft woodwind flute melody, light pizzicato strings, cozy sunlit cobblestone market atmosphere, relaxed tempo.
Pastoral, soothing countryside village theme. Rustic fingerstyle acoustic guitar, gentle ocarina and tin whistle, soft warm accordion pad, unhurried rural charm.
Serene, dappled-sunlight woodland theme. Delicate harp arpeggios, airy solo flute, soft marimba and wooden chimes, gentle sustained strings, Breath of the Wild inspired exploration.
Lush, tranquil tropical rainforest theme. Warm kalimba, soft hand percussion, wooden pan flute, gentle ambient synth pads, misty canopy atmosphere.
Airy, expansive alpine mountain theme. Sparse resonant piano, distant French horn, breathy panpipes, shimmering high strings, vast open sky and wind.
Breezy, peaceful open grassland theme. Strumming acoustic guitar, warm solo violin, light flute, gentle swaying 3/4 or 4/4 rhythm, sense of quiet freedom.
Tranquil, sun-baked desert exploration theme. Gentle oud, expressive ney flute, soft frame drum pulse, warm low string drone, calm mirage atmosphere.
Crystalline, still frozen tundra theme. Delicate celesta, glass harp, sparse high-register piano, soft icy ambient strings, quiet winter night.
Misty, calm yet mysterious marshland theme. Low clarinet and bassoon, gentle plucked harp, soft water-drop marimba, muted atmospheric pads.
Relaxed, sunlit coastal beach theme. Warm nylon-string guitar, gentle steelpan and marimba, soft ukulele, unhurried ocean-wave rhythm.
Quiet, ancient stone ruins theme. Reverberant solo piano, harp harmonics, soft ethereal pad, contemplative and timeless.
Echoing, tranquil red-rock canyon theme. Warm slide acoustic guitar, low wooden flute, sparse soft percussion, wide canyon breeze.

tracks.scene: 地球大廳 / 星海 (Lobby / Starfield)
tracks.prompt: Dreamy, nostalgic starry-sky observatory theme. Gentle solo piano, warm chamber strings, soft celesta sparkles, peaceful anticipation.
Quiet, echoing subterranean cave theme. Resonant sparse piano, water-drop marimba, subtle low bowed strings, soft cavern reverb, calm mineral stillness.
Calm yet mysterious ancient labyrinth theme. Delicate plucked harp, understated steady pizzicato strings, soft clarinet motif, enigmatic and focused atmosphere.
Tranquil, weightless deep-sea abyss theme. Warm deep ambient pads, slow distant cello swells, shimmering celesta chimes, serene submerged drift.
Nimble, energetic mid-scale boss battle theme. Crisp fast chamber strings, punchy snare and tom percussion, sharp horn accents, agile heroic skirmish energy.
